title: Copilot Studio: improvements to the agent evaluations experience
summary: Hold: the credit-allocation API call omits the environment scope and allocation body needed to use it, and the connector-blocking path skips its action menu. Microsoft also documents a resource-threshold API despite the automation gap shown here, and says environment-group policy can prevent changes to tenant-capacity draw. The roadmap facts and most evaluation, licensing and data-access statements are supported.

Select the three dots (**⋮**) next to the connector, and then:

claims.claim: The cited page gives Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant > Save.
claims.quote:
Under **Products**, select **Copilot Studio**.
4. Select **Manage Copilot Credits**.
5. Select the environment.
6. Enter the number of Copilot Credits to allocate.
7. Under **Capacity overages**, clear **Draw from the available capacity in my tenant**.
8. Select **Save**.

claims.claim: The printed allocationsV2 PUT call specifies enough request information to allocate credits and disable tenant draw.
claims.fix: The method, endpoint and version exist; the pre-check's substring miss is not evidence against them. Replace the call with 'PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01; Authorization: Bearer <access-token>; Content-Type: application/json; body: {"scope":{"environmentId":"<environment-id>"},"allocatedEntitlements":[{"entitlementId":"MCSMessages","allocation":{"quantity":<credit-quantity>},"enforcementRules":[{"ruleType":"TenantPool","enabled":false}]}]}'. The current prose omits the environment scope, allocation quantity and enclosing request structure.

claims.quote: To manage Copilot Studio capacity, you need the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: Disabling tenant-capacity draw does not prevent continued consumption through a linked pay-as-you-go plan.

claims.claim: The agent monthly-limit path is Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit > Stop usage > Save.
claims.quote:
Select **Manage Agents**.
3. Select the agent, and then select **Set limit**.
4. Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit.
5. Configure the notification threshold.
6. Turn on **Stop usage** if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.
7. Select **Save**.

claims.claim: Automation for an individual resource consumption limit is not yet documented.
claims.quote:
Create or update the resource threshold for an environment resource.

PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/{environmentId}/entitlements/{entitlementId}/resources/{resourceId}/threshold?api-version=2024-10-01
claims.fix: Replace the blanket 'Not yet documented' automation gap with the documented general resource-threshold operation: 'PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/<environment-id>/entitlements/<entitlement-id>/resources/<resource-id>/threshold?api-version=2024-10-01 with body {"limit":<consumption-limit>,"stopIfOverCapacity":true}'. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform/licensing/resource-threshold/upsert-resource-threshold. Qualify the note: 'General environment-resource threshold API; the reference does not give an agent-specific ID-mapping example.' Do not claim that no automation reference exists.
